block_row: Structural top of the accelerator with the AXI window.

frame_row: Structural top that holds the register block, the bus window, the bus-domain control, the crossings and the core-domain datapath.

label: u_csr
(m_vlsit_csr_aesgcm)
blocks.function: Register block that holds configuration, status, events and the programmed-input/output event sideband.

label: u_bus_dom
(m_aesgcm_bus_dom)
blocks.function: Bus-domain control: decodes commands, checks the configuration, takes the configuration snapshot, forms events and the interrupt, drives the programmed-input/output path and the DMA request channels, and holds the bus subordinate of the data window.

label: u_xing
(m_aesgcm_xing)
blocks.function: Clock-domain crossings: configuration and status bundles, command events and the two width-converting data FIFOs.

label: u_core_dom
(m_aesgcm_core_dom)
blocks.function: Core-domain datapath: message sequencer, key select, block formatting, authentication hash, tag logic, context store and the AES core.

interfaces.name: Register bus
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_apb_psel, i_apb_penable, i_apb_pwrite, i_apb_paddr, i_apb_pwdata, i_apb_pstrb, i_apb_pprot; TOP -> external: o_apb_pready, o_apb_prdata, o_apb_pslverr; i_protect_en, i_slverr_en

interfaces.name: Data window bus
interfaces.signals: write and read address, data, response channels of the subordinate profile (section 6.2)

interfaces.name: Direct-memory-access handshake
interfaces.signals: TOP -> external: o_dma_in_req, o_dma_out_req; external -> TOP: i_dma_in_ack, i_dma_out_ack

interfaces.name: Key side-load
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_key_side_valid, i_key_side_size, i_key_side; TOP -> external: o_key_side_ack

interfaces.name: Clocks, resets and test control
interfaces.signals: i_clk_bus, i_clk_core, i_rst_n_bus, i_rst_n_core, i_dft_scan_mode, i_dft_scan_rst_n

interfaces.name: Register field interface
interfaces.signals: u_csr -> u_bus_dom: register-field controls and sideband events; u_bus_dom -> u_csr: status and hardware loads

interfaces.name: Bus-side interface of the crossings
interfaces.signals: u_bus_dom -> u_xing: configuration snapshot, commands, input stream beats and push, output stream pop; u_xing -> u_bus_dom: status bundle, output stream beats, FIFO levels

interfaces.name: Core-side bundles and blocks
interfaces.signals: u_xing -> u_core_dom: configuration bundle, commands, input blocks; u_core_dom -> u_xing: status bundle, output blocks

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; blocks inside are its instances. The reset synchronizers sit at the frame boundary and are described by the CRCLK interface.
